officialRulebookTextOccurrences.sourceText: The base game contains 27 Serious Wound cards.
Shuffle the Serious Wound deck separately, place it face down, and leave space for its discard pile.
Serious Wounds introduce major negative effects and reduce current and maximum usable Health; a Health marker may never move to a covered slot.
Draw a random Serious Wound and place it in the leftmost Health Section without one; exact duplicates are possible and their effects do not stack.
If the Health marker is in the section receiving the Wound, move it to the first empty slot in the next Section; this may discard Armor.
When discarding one of multiple Serious Wounds, the affected Character may choose which; slide the rest left, and do not move Health merely because a Wound was discarded.
Components are limited to the supplied physical quantity; when a component is unavailable, that part of an effect does nothing unless a specific fallback is stated.
